# Backend -- rules and checks (generated from backend.json; do not edit)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| **status** | generated by build_kit.py; source of record is `angles/backend.json` |
| **updated** | on every `build_kit.py` run |
| Purpose | Fix where the data comes from, what the app may touch, and what it may never do on its own, per kind. |
| Artifact | the Backend row of APP.md; one optional file, data-policy.json, only when a chat calls a panel API |

## Questions

| id | question | required for | optional | v1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| B1 | What information does it work with, and where does that live? | page, chat, link | no | yes |
| B2 | Does any of it name a real borrower, account or loan number? | page, chat | no | end |
| B3 | Which folder may this chat read and write? | chat | no | yes |
| B4 | Anything it must never do on its own: run commands, install things, send messages? | chat | no | yes |
| B5 | Which screen should this open? | link | no | yes |

## Rules

| id | rule | kinds | Sutra source | enforced by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| BA-1 | A page has no network. fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, EventSource, sendBeacon, dynamic import(), <script src>, <link href> and @import all fail silently. | page | modules_api.py PAGE_CSP; static/js/18-modules.js sandbox=allow-scripts; APPS-THREATS.md information disclosure | CSP and iframe sandbox block it silently; C25 turns the silence into a named failure |
| BA-2 | A page's data lives inline in index.html. assets/** is a package member but no route serves it, so a relative reference is a dead image at runtime. | page | modules_api.py page_html; modules_pkg.py whitelist; APPS-THREATS.md X-3 | C26 prints the specific assets message; standing gap, flagged not papered over |
| BA-3 | Images and fonts come from data: or blob: only. | page | modules_api.py PAGE_CSP img-src/font-src | runtime CSP; C26 |
| BA-4 | Only a chat can reach a panel API, and every call needs an entry in data-policy.json carrying the call, why, a threat note and a check id. A page's allowlist is empty by construction. | page, chat | APPS-THREATS.md; modules_api.py PAGE_CSP | C26 for the page arm; C38 for the chat arm |
| BA-5 | A chat's instructions are the visible first message. No key, password, token or account number goes in them. | chat | static/js/18-modules.js modOpenChat; 2026-09-08-modules-design.md D-M19 | C28 (all kinds), C13 |
| BA-6 | surface.cwd is absolute, under $HOME, at most 1024 characters. Outside $HOME the server silently substitutes the default workdir. | chat | modules_api.py create_module cwd; providers.py workdir confinement | C29, which fails loudly where the server falls back silently |
| BA-7 | Instructions must not order a command the owner did not write down. Whatever the chat may run is listed verbatim in the Backend row's Owner notes. | chat | APPS-THREATS.md elevation of privilege | C30, over a fixed verb list only |
| BA-8 | A link's target is a live screen id, never terminal or usage, never a URL, and surface carries nothing else (user-created links; system seeds keep their shape). | link | modules_api.py SCREEN_RE, LINK_FORBIDDEN, create_module; static/js/01-state.js DEST_PLANES | C32; create_module refuses extra surface keys on user links |
| BA-9 | Nothing leaves the machine. Export and import stay off until the owner switches them on, and an export writes a local file. | page, chat, link | modules_api.py PUBLISH_FLAG; modules_pkg.py; APPS-THREATS.md X-10 | server flag gate; stated once in the Backend row, no check id of its own |
| BA-10 | Before an app is handed to someone else, the record declares the data as one of: real, masked, made-up, aggregate. | page, chat | lib/domains_page.py withholding on publish; modules_pkg.py | C31, an enum match on the B2 cell |

## Checks

| id | level | kinds | v1 | what | evaluator |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| C25 | kind-required | page | must-fix | No network call anywhere in the page. | regex over index.html and any .js/.htm in the folder: fetch(, XMLHttpRequest, new WebSocket, EventSource, navigator.sendBeacon, import(, importScripts, <script src=, <link href=, @import, <form, target=_top/_parent, window.top; any hit FAILs with file and line |
| C26 | kind-required | page | must-fix | Everything the page references is inline: data:, blob: or a # anchor. | HTMLParser collects src, href, srcset, poster, action plus CSS url() and @font-face src; any other scheme or a bare relative path FAILs; assets/ gets the 'no route serves it' message; /api/ gets 'a page cannot reach the panel' |
| C27 | kind-required | page | suggest | The B1 answer does not assume reach the page does not have. | keyword scan of the B1 cell: fetch|http|api call|endpoint|database|localstorage|saves? (it|them|the data)|uploads?|reads? my .*\.(csv|json|xlsx); a hit FAILs and names the page's real reach; the documented waiver case |
| C28 | required | page, chat, link | must-fix | No secret anywhere in the app folder. | pattern over module.json, index.html, APP.md, data-policy.json and assets text files: sk-, ghp_, github_pat_, AKIA, xox[baprs]-, AIza, BEGIN PRIVATE KEY, (api[_-]?key|secret|password|token)\s*[:=]\s*quoted 12+ chars; values masked to the last four characters |
| C29 | kind-required | chat | must-fix | The chat's folder is real, absolute and under $HOME. | surface.cwd absent PASSes; present must be a string <= 1024 chars, absolute, realpath under expanduser('~'), and the directory must exist; FAIL quotes what the server would silently substitute |
| C30 | kind-required | chat | suggest | Every command on the watched verb list that the instructions mention is one the owner wrote down. | scan surface.instructions for curl , wget , | sh, bash -c, npm install, pip install, rm -rf, git push, ssh , open -a, osascript, launchctl; each hit must have the same verb in the Backend row's Owner notes |
| C31 | advisory | page, chat | suggest | The B2 cell declares the data as one of a fixed set. | the cell's first word, lowercased, is in {real, masked, made-up, aggregate}; kind-required once P7 names someone else |
| C32 | kind-required | link | must-fix | The link opens a live screen and its surface carries nothing else. | surface.screen matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,40}$, is in screens.json (generated from SCREEN_IDS), not terminal or usage; surface has exactly the one key screen; folder holds no index.html and no assets/; user-created links only |
| C38 | kind-required | chat | must-fix | data-policy.json matches its schema when a panel API is called, and is absent when none is. | when surface.instructions or the Backend row names a /api/ call the file must exist, parse and validate against data-policy.schema.json (each panel_apis entry carries call, why, threat, check_id in this kit); when no panel call is named the file must be absent; present with empty panel_apis FAILs 'delete this file, nothing calls the panel' |
